bundle.shortDescription: Automatically sync real Microsoft 365 interactions to Excel or SharePoint.
bundle.longDescription: Atlas exports real calendar, mail, Teams, and user-authored manual interactions into one configured local or SharePoint Circana tracker, with automatic sync, a bundled local-only AI runtime, persistent diagnostics, and no invented filler data.
